summary: Trace how an application communicates across hosts and separate the layers that fail in different ways.
outcomes: Distinguish names, IP addresses, ports and connections
Explain packet delivery, TCP byte streams and application message framing
sequence: Draw two hosts and the network between them
Resolve a service name and identify its endpoint
Route packets across a simplified network
Compare datagrams with an ordered reliable byte stream
Frame application messages and diagnose a failed connection

visual.question: Does one socket read correspond to one application message?
visual.interaction: Split and combine delivered bytes while preserving a correctly framed message

practice.task: Specify a small local client/server exchange with framing
practice.success: Partial reads, connection failure and name/address/port roles are handled distinctly
